description: Annotates every image in a directory with a zero-shot open-vocabulary model (SAM3 by default) — no training, no class supports. Detects with free-text concepts, visual exemplar boxes, or both, optionally tiled (SAHI) for large imagery with small objects, via the zero-shot-annotation Tapis app.

outputs.name: annotations
outputs.description: Directory containing the run's annotations_<model>_<timestamp>.json (and, with output_format 'coco'/'both', annotations_coco_<model>_<timestamp>.json) — filenames carry a timestamp, so this port resolves to the containing directory rather than a single fixed file.

prompt_mode.description: Which kind of prompt drives detection. 'text' uses free-text concepts typed below. 'exemplar' uses visual exemplar boxes (plus optional paired text) from an uploaded prompt file. UI-only — doesn't change what's sent to the job; text_prompts and prompt_file are independently included whenever set, so the two can be combined.

text_prompts.description: Free-text concepts to detect, applied to every image (e.g. tree, "parked car", "solar panel"). Each detection is labelled with the prompt that found it. At least one of text_prompts or prompt_file is required.

prompt_file.description: JSON file with per-image exemplar boxes (SAM3 geometry prompts) and/or additional text prompts. Exemplar boxes are absolute pixel coordinates in a specific image, keyed by path relative to the image directory, bare filename, or 'default'. At least one of text_prompts or prompt_file is required.

model.description: Backend model from the zero-shot registry.

model_id.description: HuggingFace checkpoint override for the chosen backend. Blank uses the backend's default (facebook/sam3 for the sam3 backend).

is_sahi.description: Slice each image into overlapping tiles before inference (SAHI) — improves detection of small objects in large imagery. Tile count grows quickly: images x prompts x tiles inferences per run.

tile_size.description: Tile size in pixels. Only used when SAHI is enabled.

overlap_ratio.description: Fractional overlap (0-1) between adjacent tiles, so an object spanning a tile boundary is still fully captured in at least one tile. Only used when SAHI is enabled.

exemplar_tile_mode.description: With SAHI + exemplar prompts: 'intersecting' runs only tiles holding a positive exemplar (skipped tiles are logged). 'all' runs every tile, falling back to the exemplar's paired text on tiles with no visible exemplar (recorded as prompt_type 'text'). Only used when a prompt_file is set.

exemplar_min_visibility.description: Minimum fraction (0-1) of an exemplar box's area that must fall inside a tile to count as visible there; the box is then clipped to the tile. Only used when a prompt_file is set.

batch_size.description: Tiles per inference batch (not images — batches fill across images). Higher values are faster but use more GPU memory; a CUDA OOM falls back automatically to one tile at a time for that batch.

confidence.description: Minimum score (0-1) for keeping a detected instance.

mask_threshold.description: Threshold (0-1) for binarising predicted masks before they're turned into polygons.

nms_iou.description: IoU threshold (0-1) for merging detections across tiles and prompts via Non-Maximum Suppression.

class_agnostic_nms.description: Let detections from different prompts suppress each other during NMS, collapsing a text prompt and an exemplar prompt that both find the same object into a single box. Off by default, so each prompt keeps its own annotation.

no_segmentation.description: Skip mask-to-polygon extraction — boxes only, faster.

output_format.description: 'flat' matches the rest of this repo's annotation format. 'coco' writes standard COCO images/annotations/categories JSON. 'both' writes each.

max_images.description: Annotate at most this many images — useful for smoke tests. 0 annotates every image.

hf_token.description: Team secret holding a HuggingFace access token with access to the gated facebook/sam3 checkpoint (huggingface.co/facebook/sam3 — request access, then create a token under HF account settings). Add it via the dashboard's secrets settings, then pick it here; passed to the job as the HF_TOKEN env var. Leave unset only if the checkpoint is already cached on the exec system and HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 is set.

fileInputs.name: prompt_file
fileInputs.description: Optional: exemplar/text prompt JSON, staged in when prompt_file is set.
